papers.title: Synthetic Paper A
papers.goal: Find a structured approach to a finite grid counting task.
public_steps: Define the finite set and the allowed transformations.
Classify configurations by an explicitly stated equivalence relation.
papers.reference_idea: Use orbit representatives to avoid duplicate counting.

papers.title: Synthetic Paper B
papers.goal: Study an elementary polynomial identity under supplied hypotheses.
papers.obstacle: A coefficient comparison produces many linked equations.
papers.reference_idea: Evaluate at selected points to triangularize the system.

papers.title: Synthetic Paper C
papers.obstacle: The direct recurrence depends on several graph states.
public_steps: Define the graph operation and the invariant.
papers.reference_idea: Introduce a state vector that closes under the operation.
